row:
Helping smart chiropractors build smarter practices.

The Smart Chiropractor is your go-to YouTube channel for chiropractic marketing, business growth, clinical education, mindset, and AI tools built specifically for practicing chiropractors.

Dr. Jeff Langmaid and Dr. Jason Deitch have spent over a decade helping chiropractors in 100+ countries see more of the right patients, keep them engaged, and build practices that support their lives — not the other way around.

On this channel you'll find:
🤖 AI tools and strategies for chiropractors
📈 Chiropractic marketing and practice growth
🎙️ Podcasts and long-form conversations
🧠 Mindset and personal development for DCs
🔬 Clinical education and research
📺 Reception area and patient education videos

New content dropped regularly.

🔔 Subscribe and go beyond the adjustment.
Learn more at thesmartchiropractor.com
